extrabotany.page.voidcaller0: A beacon, four Gaia pylons, and a clean inventory are required before the void will answer. Sneak-use this item on the beacon to call the Herrscher.
extrabotany.page.empty_core_of_the_void0: A hollow core left after the void has fallen silent. It is only a material, but it can anchor a true Core of the Void.
extrabotany.page.herrscher1: The Herrscher uses shield layers, rotating shields, subspace spears, skull mines, missiles, and judgment swords. Her red mines deal lethal magic through the normal damage pipeline.
extrabotany.page.herrscher2: Only items from Minecraft, Botania, and Extrabotany may be carried when calling this guardian.
extrabotany.message.advancement_required: You must defeat the Herrscher of the Void before using this relic.
